page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.p: bus appellare superiores judices placet, à Senatu Groningano, temporibus in fœdere Doccumano expressis, recognoscantur: cæteræ lites aut cum peregrinis, aut peregrinorum cum iisdem peregrinis, id est, iis qui Leoardiæ domicilium non habent, ab Ho-vetmannis Groningensibus, & conventu juridico sociorum, ut est in eodem fœdere Doccumano, definiantur. Dein additum, ut Groningani præfectum dent Leoardianis, qui vel in oppido, vel in ejus vicinia commodo loco sedem habeat: isque scabini aut senioris locum teneat in senatu oppidano eaque potestate sit, quâ ipse, si adsit, senatus Groninganus,, cujus vicem geret: eidemque præfecto Leoardiani stipendium solvant decennio proximo aureos Rhenanos centenos annuos: interea socii rationem ineant aliam stipendii ejusdem conficiendi, quæ durèt ad fœderis usque finem, sintque Leoardiani ab onere illo centenorum aureorum deinceps li-beri. Præfectum hunc si quis aufu temerario occidat, prehensus capite pœnas vicissim pendat, fugâ elapsus omnibus bonis mobilibus & immobilibus exuatur, eaque ad arbitrium senatus in siscum redigantur Gro-ningensium:Nota A.

page.notes: The note "Nota A." stands in the left margin, its exact line is uncertain; I placed it at the point where the margin label sits. Small quotation-like marks (,, or ") in the left margin beside several lines and a dash-like mark at the left margin near the bottom of the column are margin marks, not text, and were not transcribed as words. The ",," after "Groninganus" is transcribed as printed. The leading "bus" is a fragment continued from the previous page. Running head and page number are as printed with long s normalised to s.
